# The HARD-TIER API surface, in apidiff's own naming, one identifier per line.
#
# This file is the MACHINE-CHECKABLE half of docs/api-tiers.md: scripts/apidiff_check.sh fails the
# build when apidiff reports an INCOMPATIBLE change to any name here, and reports incompatible
# changes to everything else as informational (those surfaces are named Experimental in the doc,
# explicitly and on purpose).
#
# TestAPITiers_hardListMatchesDoc keeps the two from drifting: every name here must appear in
# docs/api-tiers.md. A name added to one and not the other is the failure this pair exists to stop —
# a promise in prose that no gate checks, or a gate checking a promise nobody documented.
#
# Format: <pkg> <apidiff-name>.  Comments and blank lines ignored.

# --- decoder: load and generate -------------------------------------------------------------
decoder Load
decoder LoadGGUFBytes
decoder Options
decoder Options.Quant
decoder Options.LoRA
decoder Model
decoder (*Model).Close
decoder (*Model).Config
decoder (*Model).Dims
decoder (*Model).Quant
decoder (*Model).NewCache
decoder (*Model).NewSession
decoder (*Model).Generate
decoder (*Model).LoadSession
decoder Session
decoder (*Session).Generate
decoder (*Session).Reset
decoder (*Session).Tokens
decoder (*Session).Snapshot
decoder SamplingParams
decoder Generation
decoder (*Generation).Err
decoder KVCache
decoder Config

# --- tokenizer ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
tokenizer Load
tokenizer LoadGGUF
tokenizer LoadGGUFBytes
tokenizer LoadJSONBytes
tokenizer Tokenizer
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).Encode
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).EncodeSegments
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).Decode
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).DecodePiece
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).TokenText
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).TokenID
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).Has
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).Special
tokenizer (*Tokenizer).ChatTemplate
tokenizer Segment
tokenizer SpecialTokens

# --- chat -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

chat Meta

chat (*Template).Render
chat (*Template).RenderSegments
chat (*Template).ParseToolCalls

chat Gemma3
chat Gemma4

chat Tool
chat ToolCall
chat Stops
chat Segment
